column1: # This file is used by bin/cheatsheet for the interactive search
# 1. Add the alias/function to the appropriate file in shell/aliases/
# 2. Add an entry here following the format above
# 3. Keep entries grouped by category and alphabetically sorted within category
git│gs│Show working tree status and staged changes│git status
git│gl│Show commit history as decorated graph│git log --oneline --decorate --graph
git│ga│Stage specific files for commit│git add
git│gaa│Stage all changes in working directory│git add .
git│gau│Stage all tracked files that have changes│git add -u
git│gd│Show unstaged changes in working directory│git diff
git│gds│Show staged changes ready to commit│git diff --staged
git│gc│Create commit with editor for message│git commit
git│gcm│Create commit with inline message│git commit -m
git│gswc│Create and switch to new branch│git switch -c
git│gf│Download objects and refs from remote│git fetch
git│gfo│Download latest changes from origin remote│git fetch origin
git│gfu│Download latest changes from upstream remote│git fetch upstream
git│gfa│Download changes from all configured remotes│git fetch --all
git│gp│Upload local commits to remote│git push
git│gpl│Download and merge remote changes│git pull
git│gst│Save working changes to temporary area│git stash
git│gstp│Apply and remove most recent stash│git stash pop
git│lg│Launch interactive terminal UI for git│lazygit
git│gundo│Undo last commit but keep changes staged│git reset HEAD~1 --soft
tmux│Alt+E / Alt+D│Move focus up / down between panes; stops at the edge│select-pane -U/-D
tmux│Alt+S / Alt+F│Move left / right between panes; at the edge, the previous / next window's facing pane (wraps around)│select-pane -L/-R or previous/next-window + {right}/{left}
tmux│PgUp│Shell pane: copy mode a page up (exits at the bottom); apps scroll themselves│copy-mode -eu / send-keys PPage
tmux│Ctrl+Home│Shell pane: copy mode at the top of history; apps get the key│copy-mode -e; history-top / send-keys C-Home
tmux│Alt+1-0│Jump to window by number (no prefix)│select-window -t N
tmux│Alt+Shift+T│Insert new window after current (inherits current path)│new-window -a -c #{pane_current_path}
tmux│Alt+V│Open a compose pane (Neovim) under this pane, or switch focus between them│bin/tmux-compose toggle
tmux│Ctrl+G (Claude)│Move the prompt box into the compose pane, opening it if needed│$VISUAL is bin/compose-editor → tmux-compose editor
tmux│:q / :wq / :cq (compose on Claude)│Put the draft back in Claude's prompt box / keep it in the draft│tmux-compose return through Claude's Ctrl+G
tmux│Ctrl+Shift+G (Claude)│Edit the prompt in Neovim in Claude's place│@compose-editor fullscreen; Ctrl+G
tmux│Ctrl+S (compose)│Paste the draft into the agent and submit without interrupting it│Claude/OpenCode Ctrl+X Enter, Codex Tab; shells: paste only
tmux│Ctrl+Shift+S / ,s (compose)│Paste the draft into the agent without submitting│bin/tmux-compose stage
tmux│PgUp / PgDn / Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End (compose)│Scroll the agent's conversation from the compose pane│bin/tmux-compose forward
tmux│Ctrl+L (compose, insert)│Fix the last spelling or grammar mark before the cursor│Harper's suggestion, else Vim's first spelling suggestion
tmux│Ctrl+a Alt+ESDF│Send the original Meta key to the application│send-keys M-e/M-s/M-d/M-f
tmux│Ctrl+a Shift+↑↓←→│Resize pane 5 lines in direction (repeatable)│resize-pane -U/-D/-L/-R 5
tmux│Ctrl+a q│Show pane numbers (3s) — type number to jump│display-panes -d 3000
tmux│Ctrl+a j│Join current pane into the right side of the window to the left│join-pane -h -t :-1
tmux│Ctrl+a l│Leave current pane in a new window immediately to the right│break-pane -a
tmux│Ctrl+a g│Toggle synchronized input to all panes│setw synchronize-panes
tmux│Ctrl+a t│Insert new window after current (inherits current path)│new-window -a -c #{pane_current_path}
tmux│Ctrl+a X│Kill window and all its panes (with confirmation)│confirm-before kill-window
tmux│Ctrl+a n│Rename current window; blank restores automatic naming│command-prompt rename-window
tmux│Ctrl+a i│Insert current window at index; -1 or beyond count moves it to end│move-window -a/-b
tmux│Ctrl+a d│Detach (session keeps running in background)│detach-client
tmux│Ctrl+a v│Copy mode on what the pane shows now (in an agent: the live screen and prompt)│copy-mode / cancel

tmux│ScrollLock key / Ctrl+a f│Review the pane: copy mode; Claude's transcript in copy mode; Codex's transcript search; OpenCode's session in an nvim popup│Shift+F5 (firmware F17) → bin/tmux-review toggle
tmux│e / s / d / f (and arrows)│Review: move up / left / down / right│cursor-up/-left/-down/-right
tmux│E / S / D / F (and Shift+arrows)│Review: extend the selection, starting one if needed│begin-selection; cursor-*
tmux│Ctrl+s / Ctrl+f (and Ctrl+←/→)│Review: word left / right│previous-word / next-word-end
tmux│Ctrl+e / Ctrl+d (and Ctrl+↑/↓)│Review: previous / next prompt (Claude: its ❯ lines)│previous-prompt / next-prompt; search ^❯
tmux│Home / End│Review: start / end of the line│start-of-line / end-of-line
tmux│PgUp / PgDn│Review: page up / down│page-up / page-down
tmux│Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End│Review: top / bottom of history│history-top / history-bottom
tmux│/ and ? then n / N│Review: incremental search up / down, then next / previous result│search-backward-incremental / search-forward-incremental
tmux│o│Review: open the pane's history read-only in an nvim popup at this line (q closes)│bin/tmux-review open
tmux│v│Toggle the single tmux highlight in transcript view│begin-selection / clear-selection
tmux│Esc / q│Clear an active selection, otherwise exit / always exit transcript view│clear-selection or cancel / cancel
tmux│Alt+Copy / y│Enter copy mode or copy the selection to the tmux buffer and clipboard│C-M-Insert / copy-pipe
tmux│Copy│Copy the copy-mode selection to the tmux buffer and clipboard; in Claude, its own selection│C-Insert (WezTerm forwards it without a selection); Claude gets Ctrl+Shift+C
tmux│Ctrl+C / Ctrl+a Ctrl+C│In Claude, Esc (interrupts the turn, spares background agents) / a real Ctrl+C; elsewhere both are Ctrl+C│send-keys Escape / send-keys C-c
tmux│Ctrl+Backspace / Ctrl+Delete (Claude)│Delete the word before / after the cursor, as in the shell│send-keys M-BSpace / M-d
tmux│Alt+Backspace / Alt+Delete (Claude)│Delete to the start / end of the line, as in the shell│send-keys C-u / C-k
tmux│Alt+Paste│Paste the tmux buffer with bracketed-paste markers│M-S-Insert / paste-buffer -p
tmux│Click an inactive pane│Focus it only; the application sees neither the click nor a drag after it│MouseDown1Pane → select-pane
tmux│Alt+click│Enter copy mode at the mouse position│copy-mode -M
tmux│Alt+mouse drag│Copy to the tmux buffer and clipboard on release│copy-pipe-and-cancel
tmux│Alt+double-click│Copy clicked word to the tmux buffer and clipboard│select-word; copy-pipe-and-cancel
tmux│Alt+triple-click│Copy clicked line to the tmux buffer and clipboard│select-line; copy-pipe-and-cancel
tmux│Shift+mouse drag│Select natively in Windows Terminal│client-side selection
tmux│Ctrl+a p│Paste from tmux buffer with bracketed-paste markers when supported│paste-buffer -p
tmux│Ctrl+a y / Shift+Copy│Copy the agent's last reply (Claude: from its session file, draft untouched; Codex/OpenCode: their copy keys)│bin/tmux-last-reply
tmux│Ctrl+a e│Export current tmux buffer to the client/Windows clipboard, even with export off│size-gated OSC 52 export
tmux│Pause key / Ctrl+a E│Toggle automatic clipboard export; CLIP OFF shows while off│Shift+F6 (firmware F18) → @clipboard-export
tmux│Ctrl+a R│Force current window to attached-client size and resume automatic sizing│resize-window -A; setw window-size latest; refresh-client
tmux│Ctrl+a Ctrl+l│Clear screen and scrollback history│send-keys C-l; clear-history
vim│,gd│Open side-by-side diff of current file│:Gdiffsplit
vim│Alt+Backspace / Alt+Delete│Insert and command line: delete to the start / end of the line, as in the shells│<C-u> / setline
vim│Ctrl+U│Undo in insert, normal, and visual mode (visual leaves the selection)│u
vim│gc│Comment out motion (e.g. gcap for paragraph)│gc{motion}
vim│,ss│Strip trailing whitespace from file│:call StripTrailingWhitespace()
vim│:Theme│Pin this editor to a theme (follow = window theme)│:Theme <name|follow>
shell│Ctrl+Backspace│Delete from the cursor back through the previous word│backward-kill-word
shell│Ctrl+Delete│Delete from the cursor through the next word│kill-word
shell│Alt+Backspace│Delete from cursor to line start│backward-kill-line
shell│Alt+Delete│Delete from cursor to line end│kill-line
shell│Ctrl+Shift+Backspace│Cut previous word to tmux buffer│TAFK F13 widget
shell│Ctrl+Shift+Delete│Cut next word to tmux buffer│TAFK F14 widget
shell│Alt+Shift+Backspace│Cut from cursor to line start into tmux buffer│TAFK F15 widget
shell│Alt+Shift+Delete│Cut from cursor to line end into tmux buffer│TAFK F16 widget
shell│Shift+Tab│Spell-correct the word at the cursor (zsh)│spell-word
shell│.. [N]│Go up N directories (default 1)│cd .. N times
shell│mkcd│Create directory and cd into it│mkcd <dir>
shell│md│Render Markdown in terminal│glow (paged if interactive, print if piped)
shell│p [path...]│Print canonical current directory or resolve supplied paths│pwd -P / realpath
shell│yo <command>│Print command output and yank it to the clipboard│yo pwd
shell│psg│Search running processes by name│ps aux | grep
shell│fkill│Fuzzy-find and kill a process│FZF process selector + kill
shell│killport│Kill process on a port (--force to skip confirm)│killport <port>
shell│tm│Create new named tmux session│tmux new -s
shell│ta│Attach to existing tmux session│tmux attach -t
shell│tr│Resume most recently used tmux session (no args)│tmux attach-session
shell│ducks│Show largest items in current directory│du -cks * | sort -rn | head
shell│fixmouse│Reset stale terminal mouse-reporting modes│disable DEC/Xterm mouse modes
shell│reload [--soft]│Restart the shell in place with fresh config (--soft re-sources instead)│exec $SHELL -l
shell│theme│Set the global theme / interactive picker│theme [name]
shell│theme-window│Theme only this tmux window / picker│theme -w [name]
shell│theme-window-clear│Make this window follow the global theme│theme -w clear
shell│theme-current│Show the global, window, and Neovim themes│theme --current
shell│theme-nvim│Pin new Neovim instances to a theme (follow = window theme)│theme --nvim [name|follow]
shell│fgb│Fuzzy search and checkout git branch│fzf-git-branch
shell│fgl│Fuzzy search git log│FZF git log browser
shell│fp│Fuzzy search and open project directory│FZF project finder
shell│fr│Find and replace text across files│replace
shell│diff-config│Show drift between dotfiles sources and ~/│diff-config [--diff] [name]
shell│check-updates│Compare eget.toml pins against latest GitHub releases│check-updates [--outdated] [tool]
shell│uninstall-tool│Remove a tool installed by dotfiles (--list to inspect)│uninstall-tool <name>
shell│install-git-hooks│Install dotfiles pre-commit lint hook in this clone│install-git-hooks [--check] [--uninstall]
shell│da│Allow direnv in current directory│direnv allow
shell│show_path│Show PATH entries one per line│show_path
codex│End│Move to end of composer line│tui.keymap.editor.move_line_end
shell│cxh│Codex with alt config dir (~/.codex-alt)│CODEX_HOME=~/.codex-alt codex
shell│cxhr│Resume Codex (alt dir, picker)│CODEX_HOME=~/.codex-alt codex resume
shell│cxhc│Continue last Codex (alt dir)│CODEX_HOME=~/.codex-alt codex resume --last
shell│cxhp│One-off Codex prompt (alt dir)│CODEX_HOME=~/.codex-alt codex exec
opencode│Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End│First / last message of the session│cli.json keybinds session.first/session.last
opencode│Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab│Next / previous session tab (opencode default)│session.tab.next/previous
shell│ocrc│Run one-off opencode prompt, continuing last│opencode run --continue
shell│pir│Browse and select a past Pi session│pi -r
docker│dexec│Exec into a running container│docker exec -it
docker│dcu│Start services in background│docker compose up -d
docker│dcd│Stop and remove containers│docker compose down
docker│dcl│Tail logs from all services│docker compose logs -f
docker│dprune│Remove unused containers and images│docker system prune
docker│dprunea│Remove all unused Docker resources│docker system prune -a
docker│denter│Open bash shell in container│docker exec -it <container> /bin/bash
docker│dstopall│Stop all running containers│docker stop $(docker ps -q)
python│pyt│Run tests with verbose output│python3 -m pytest -v
python│venv│Create .venv (uses uv if available)│uv venv .venv / python3 -m venv .venv
python│pyserver│Start HTTP server in current directory│python3 -m http.server
python│pip install -e│Install package in editable/dev mode│pip install -e .
python│uvr│Run command in project environment│uv run <command>
python│uvt│Install CLI tool globally│uv tool install <tool>
python│uvpi│Install package with uv pip│uv pip install <package>
python│uv python list│List installed and available Python versions│uv python list
python│uv python install│Install a Python version│uv python install <version>
python│uv python pin│Pin Python version for current project│uv python pin <version>
python│uv venv│Create venv with a specific Python│uv venv --python <version>
node│nuke-node│Delete node_modules and lockfiles explicitly│rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json npm-shrinkwrap.json yarn.lock pnpm-lock.yaml
vscode│c│Open VS Code in current directory│code .
vscode│cproj│Fuzzy search and open project in VS Code│FZF project finder + code
vscode│cf│Fuzzy search and open file in VS Code│FZF file finder + code
vscode│cdiff│Diff two files side-by-side│code --diff file1 file2
wsl│pwsh│Launch PowerShell (7 if installed, otherwise 5)│pwsh.exe / powershell.exe
wsl│cwd│Copy current path to clipboard│pwd | clip.exe
wsl│wcd│Copy Windows-format path to clipboard│wslpath -w $(pwd) | clip.exe
wsl│wpath│Convert Linux path to Windows format│wslpath -w
wsl│lpath│Convert Windows path to Linux format│wslpath -u
diagramming│dot│Render Graphviz DOT graph to image│dot -Tpng input.dot -o output.png
